_about: High-variety human-voiced admiral lines (720 admiral entries + boss pools). Every admiral line <= 22 words (story_test.gd). Sector arrays are ordered [Sector I, Sector II, Sector III]. Never put 'The ' before {flagship}. US English, space-first, no em or en dashes.

vex.pick: Keep your intervals tight and your radiators clear. Hold formation and we'll outlast anything ahead.
sector: Jump complete out of Vesper orbit. Warm the flank batteries and double-check your firing arcs.
Deeper into contested space, and the relays are dead. Keep escorts tucked close to the heavies.
There's the Hollow Sun on forward scopes. Check your bulkheads, everyone; we're finishing this here.
start: Lock bearings on my flagship and roll into firing lanes on my mark.
Hold fire till they close inside five! Then open every flank battery at once.
Keep moving, keep angled, and don't give them a clean shot at our sterns.
Form up tight on my port side. Make them fight through our whole line.
boss: Big armored brick dead ahead. Good, we've got enough iron on our flanks to crack it.
There's their command ship. Don't scatter; walk every flank gun down its mid-hull together.
nemesis: There you are, {rival}. Chalked your hull code on my bulkhead back home; today I scrub it off.
So that's {rival}. Every gunner in this fleet has your ship's profile pinned up by now.
kill_flag: Their flagship's breaking up! Log the kill time and sweep the escorts before they jump.
Command hull's down! Keep pressure on their remaining ships while they're blind.
Reactor's gone on their lead ship! Clean shooting, everybody, finish the lane.
lost: We just lost a hull. Close the gap right now; we'll chalk their names after!
Hull down on the flank! Don't stare at the debris, tighten the line!
Lost a good crew there. Hold your bearings and make whoever fired pay for it.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s venting atmosphere on three decks, yet the main mounts still track. Hold steady!
Heavy hits on {flagship}! Roll the scorched flank away and keep firing!
{flagship}'s taking a beating! Escorts, draw some heat off our bow right now!
command: All ships, free fire on my telemetry! Put every ready battery into them now!
Open every firing circuit across the line! Hit them before they can pivot!
Give them everything that's hot! Synchronize off my flagship and fire!
win: Good shooting, everyone. Stand down to watch condition, get welders moving, and check casualties.
Lane's clear. Cycle down the radiators and pull any intact parts off those wrecks.
Solid work out there. Patch the hull leaks and fuel up before the next jump.
They broke first. Get damage control rolling and log who brought us through.
loss: Formation's gone. If anyone's drive still answers, jump home and tell Vesper we held.
Too many breaches at once. Abandon ship if you've got working pods left.

malek.pick: Deserters and raiders always leave a sloppy drive trail. Give me fast hulls and full tubes.
sector: Fresh lanes out of Vesper. Pull local beacon traffic; whoever's flying clean is hiding something.
Every relay in this sector's been tampered with. Keep active pings low and watch our wake.
Hollow Sun's right ahead, and every liar in three sectors is running toward it.
start: Tube doors open, warheads armed. Find me an exposed stern and stay off forward scopes.
They think we're a slow frontier convoy. Correct them before round two.
Swing wide on both flanks and keep our drive plumes tight until launch range.
Ignore their front armor. Pin down their turn vectors and drop torpedoes up their tail.
boss: Heavy forward armor means bare rear radiators. Swing wide and put a salvo straight into the engines.
Big command hull, slow pivot. Herd it into a turn and punish the aft plating.
nemesis: Pulled three jumps of telemetry on you, {rival}. You favor the same turn under pressure.
Finally pinned you down, {rival}. No blind jump gates left to hide behind today.
kill_flag: Command ship's dead in space. Pin the survivors before they purge their flight recorders.
Torpedoes found the magazine. Sweep the escorts and grab any intact beacons.
That's their flagship cracked open. Nobody lets an escort slip off the plot.
lost: We're down one hunter. Tag the hull that fired; I want it burning this round.
Lost a fast escort. Watch your flank arcs and don't fly predictable lines.
Good crew gone. Note who took that shot and put the next salvo in their engines.
flag_hurt: {flagship} took a bad hit. Tuck the damaged flank away and cycle the torpedo racks!
Breach alerts on {flagship}! Keep moving so they don't get a second clean lock!
{flagship}'s bleeding coolant! Shift angle and burn straight into their blind spot!
command: Flush every tube and push hard! Reload on the burn and hit them from behind!
Cycle all torpedo racks immediately! Catch them while their point defense is turned!
All hulls, max output! Put fresh warheads straight into their aft bulkheads!
win: Last hostile's dark. Sweep the wrecks for flight logs and burn what we can't tow.
Clean intercept. Pull their transponder records before the batteries die.
That's what happens when you leave your stern unguarded. Reload tubes and move on.
Field's quiet. Check every debris cloud for stragglers running cold.
loss: Better ambush than my scouts called. Won't trust unverified jump charts again.
Outmaneuvered in our own lane. Dump the cipher cores before the bridge goes.

ashgrove.pick: Give my squadrons a clean launch vector and keep flak off their tails. Pilots handle the rest.
sector: Clear of jump wake. Wing leaders, check launch rails and oxygen seals before we pick a lane.
Tight debris belts in this sector, just how my bombers like it. Keep the bays hot.
The Hollow Sun's dead ahead, kids. One last stretch; fly sharp and watch each other's tails.
start: Hangar bays open, scramble all wings! Get eyes on their carrier before they form up.
Fighters on close screen, bombers on the flank. Don't fly straight through flak!
Launch rails clear! Push the wings wide and force their turrets to split fire.
All callsigns green! Swarm their heavy hulls before their escorts close ranks.
boss: Look at that slow command hull. Wide blind spots; my bombers are going to love this.
Heavy flagship ahead! Fighters, chew up its escort screen so bombers get a clean run.
nemesis: Heads up on flight channel, {rival} just jumped in. Every pilot here's been waiting for this.
There's {rival}'s flagship! Stay nimble, kids, the briefing says they hunt wings first.
kill_flag: Bombers confirm the flagship's cracked open! Good flying, kids, bring it back to the rails.
Direct hits on their command core! Pull the wings clear of the blast wave!
Flagship's slag! Best bombing run I've seen all campaign, now sweep the stragglers.
lost: Hull down! Search-and-rescue, mark every escape beacon the second firing slows!
We just lost a ship! Wings, tighten cover before they pick off another!
Bad break on the flank. Keep flying, kids; we'll pull survivors out after.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s taking heavy fire! Pull second and third wings back on close screen now!
Hits along {flagship}'s hangar deck! Clear those bandits off our flank!
{flagship}'s screens are buckling! Fighters, intercept everything heading our way!
command: Launch everything on the racks! If it's got thrusters and a warhead, get it out!
Scramble all reserve wings! Flood every flight lane at once!
Bays wide open! Double sortie on my mark, hit them while they're reloading!
win: All wings, RTB and cycle down. Nice work; hangar crews have hot rations waiting.
Clear flight lanes! Bring the birds home and check every wing for flak holes.
Couldn't ask for cleaner flying. Re-arm the bays and let the pilots catch their breath.
Hostiles cleared. Good tally today, everyone; get back in the cradles.
loss: Bays are empty and half my callsigns aren't answering. I sent them out there... damn it.
Hangar decks are gone. Tell any surviving wings to jump clear without us.

thale.pick: Three failed expeditions out of Vesper, and I'm still breathing because I reinforce the bulkheads first.
sector: Cold outer lanes ahead. Keep screens topped off and don't let the younger captains sprint ahead.
Sector two's where impatient fleets run dry on repair plate. Keep your pace steady.
Finally made it to the Hollow Sun's rim. Didn't think these old ribs would see it.
start: Bring screens to full and let them waste their first salvo on our front plate.
Easy now, helm. Soak the opening punch and answer once they're inside optimal range.
No rushing. Lock the bulkheads, hold steady, and let them burn their ammo first.
Steady advance, everyone. Heavy iron beats fancy flying when the guns stay hot.
boss: Well, that's a stubborn piece of iron. Good thing we've got all afternoon to chew it.
Big command ship dead ahead. Lean on its shields until something cracks.
nemesis: So you're the one hunting us, {rival}? Dump your magazines into our screens; let's see what's left after.
First look at you, {rival}. Hope you brought heavier guns than the rumors say.
kill_flag: Their big ship finally gave out. Always takes longer than the young ones expect, doesn't it?
Command hull's done. See what happens when you don't panic?
There goes their flagship. Steady fire wins out every single time.
lost: Lost a good captain there. Close the formation so the rest of us get through.
One hull down. Steady on the helm; panicking only loses a second.
Tough hit on the flank. Pull the survivors tighter behind our screens.
flag_hurt: Relax, bridge, {flagship}'s limped home with half her ribs showing before. Hold steady.
Bit warm on {flagship}'s bridge! Seal the vents and keep the guns rolling.
{flagship}'s armor is taking a pounding, and it's still holding. Don't flinch now.
command: Dump reserve power into the screen emitters and lock bulkheads! Ride it out!
All ships, reinforce screens to maximum! Let them break their teeth on our armor!
Brace the whole line and top off capacitors! Nothing punches through this round!
win: Still standing, more or less in one piece. Get welders out and see what's salvageable.
They ran out of hull before we ran out of patience. Good work.
Nice and steady. Patch the scorch marks and pour the bridge crew some tea.
We're still breathing and they're drifting. That's a good day in my book.
loss: Looks like the armor finally gave out before my luck did. Tell Vesper we held.
Well, three expeditions was a solid run. Get the young crews into escape pods.

kassar.pick: A fleet firing out of sequence wastes half its mass. Synchronize the clocks and hold interval.
sector: Transition complete. Meridian projects a favorable attrition curve provided every captain preserves spacing.
Mid-sector transit underway. Tighten escort intervals; hostile contact density increases from this relay onward.
We have reached the Hollow Sun perimeter. Maintain textbook synchronization regardless of interference.
start: All batteries, synchronize to the flagship clock and hold fire until my mark.
Assume standard column spacing. Maintain two-hex intervals and confirm sensor lock.
Link fire-control arrays to the flagship. Zero uncoordinated shots on round one.
Advance at regulated burn. Let the synchronized volley resolve the opening exchange.
boss: The opposing flagship anchors their command net. Concentrate synchronized fire on its emitters immediately.
High-tonnage command vessel identified. Collapse its shields in a single coordinated salvo.
nemesis: Priority contact confirmed as {rival}. Update the Registry dossier and establish a clean firing arc.
{rival} has entered range. Apply the tactical revisions from this morning's dossier.
kill_flag: Opposing command vessel neutralized. Note the volley count for the efficiency review.
Enemy flagship offline. Maintain column geometry and clear the remaining escorts.
Primary target destroyed cleanly. Shift synchronized fire to the nearest cruiser.
lost: One hull removed from the column. Close the interval and maintain firing discipline.
Escort casualty confirmed. Recalculate firing arcs without breaking formation.
Hull lost within projected variance. Continue advancing on schedule.
flag_hurt: {flagship} has sustained structural breaches. Disregard alarms and preserve formation geometry.
Damage confirmed on {flagship}. Keep the sync anchor active and hold position.
{flagship}'s plating is compromised. Escorts, maintain two-hex spacing and suppress enemy batteries.
command: Synchronized volley on my mark. Every battery, one firing window.
Link all firing circuits to the flagship clock. Engage simultaneously now.
Full column discharge authorized. Fire as a single instrument.
win: Engagement concluded with casualties inside projected tolerances. Begin salvage assessment.
Lane secured cleanly. Transmit updated combat logs to Meridian.
Hostile signatures removed. Verify ammunition stocks and resume transit.
Firing discipline produced the expected result. Stand down to cruise watch.
loss: Formation integrity has failed. Log the error under my serial and withdraw surviving pickets.
Casualty limits exceeded. Transmit the black box before command links sever.

vorn.pick: Luck is what unprepared officers call an uncomputed intercept. Give me clean telemetry.
sector: Interdiction beacons deployed across the jump gate. Nothing enters this sector untracked.
Sensor clutter rises in these inner lanes. Recalibrate optical arrays before engaging.
Gravity shear near the Hollow Sun distorts long-range locks. Compensate three degrees before firing.
start: Hold fire until telemetry stabilizes. Wait for the full firing solution.
Interdiction fields active. If they attempt to flank, pin their drives with ion fire.
Map their velocity vectors first. One verified hit beats three hasty salvos.
Lock targeting computers onto their lead escort and wait for optimal range.
boss: Every heavy vessel carries a thermal blind spot along its radiators. I have tagged theirs.
Command hull telemetry locked. Strip its shields with ion fire and isolate the reactor.
nemesis: {rival} favors predictable approach curves under stress. Pre-calculate the turn and fire ahead.
Telemetry matches the dossier on {rival}. Their flank drift is exactly as reported.
kill_flag: Command hull destroyed. The intercept solution held within two percent.
Flagship neutralized precisely where modeled. Reassign targeting locks to the escorts.
Clean reactor breach. Archive the firing telemetry before clearing the field.
lost: We have lost an escort. Recompute firing arcs and adjust the intercept grid.
Friendly hull removed from the plot. Compensate for the lost sensor node.
Casualty logged. Do not allow emotional adjustments to degrade aiming precision.
flag_hurt: {flagship} has taken hull damage, though primary optics remain aligned. Continue firing.
Structural alert on {flagship}. Keep the sensor mast clear and finish the volley.
{flagship} is bleeding power. Reroute auxiliary output to fire control immediately.
command: Interdiction strike authorized. All hulls, engage tagged vectors simultaneously.
Firing solutions verified across the fleet. Execute maximum output now.
Target locks confirmed at ninety-eight percent. Discharge all weapons.
win: Sector lane cleared on schedule. Archive telemetry for Meridian.
Opposing fleet dismantled cleanly. Minimal ammunition waste.
The intercept grid performed within parameters. Prepare for the next jump.
Zero active hostiles remaining. Download sensor captures and stand down.
loss: My firing projection missed a critical variable. Transmit the logs before hull failure.
Calculation error confirmed too late. Authorize remaining ships to disengage.

reyes.pick: Mark the priority hull on the plot, and my strike group will dissect it.
sector: Long sortie ahead. Flight ops, cycle drone links and verify squadron fuel before departure.
Hostile carriers operate heavily in this sector. Keep interceptors primed on the launch rails.
Final approach to the Hollow Sun. Strike group, fly tight and watch for flak traps.
start: Strike group, clear the bays and sweep their outer picket lanes.
Wings deployed. Pin their escorts down so the heavy hulls can work undisturbed.
Interceptors ahead on screen; bombers hold until ion fire drops their shields.
Clear flight corridors first. Nobody commits bombers into active point defense.
boss: That command ship is worth more than its entire escort screen. Mark its shield emitters.
Heavy flagship on scopes. Strike group, strip its flanks before it settles into formation.
nemesis: {rival} at last. My wing leaders studied every report on them and want the first pass.
{rival} is on the plot. Keep wings dispersed until we read their flak coverage.
kill_flag: Enemy flagship confirmed destroyed. Clean run, strike group; return to screen.
Command hull down. Recall the bombers and let fighters mop up their stragglers.
Primary target cracked cleanly. Commendation noted for the lead bomber wing.
lost: One ship down. Keep the wings in the air and finish the engagement.
Escort lost on the flank. Divert one interceptor wing to cover the gap.
Casualty logged. Hold formation so the carriers stay protected.
flag_hurt: {flagship} is taking direct hits. Intercept squadrons, collapse back to close screen.
Breach alerts on {flagship}. Pull fighters tight around the flight bays immediately.
{flagship} is losing armor. Screen the carrier decks until repairs cycle.
command: Full strike launch across all carriers. Put every wing in the flight corridor.
Deploy all reserve squadrons and push a second attack pass immediately.
Strike group, full saturation run on my beacon. Clear the board.
win: Objective achieved. Recover surviving wings and prepare the casualty ledger.
Clean sortie. Cycle the launch rails and check every frame for damage.
Flight lanes clear. Good coordination between carriers and escorts today.
Hostiles eliminated. Bring the squadrons home and log flight hours.
loss: The strike group is spent. Meridian will close their serials; I will remember the names.
Carriers lost and flight lanes broken. Order surviving pilots to clear the sector.

maren.pick: Speed gets escorts killed. Heavy armor and steady deflectors grind every clever maneuver down.
sector: Bring heavy hulls forward and balance deflectors. We advance at column speed and yield nothing.
Rougher opposition in these lanes. Keep the thick bows angled into incoming fire.
The Hollow Sun lies ahead. Hold the armored column intact all the way to the rim.
start: Heavy plating forward, deflectors at maximum. Advance at steady burn.
Close up on the flagship and let our armor absorb their opening salvo.
Do not chase fast escorts. Hold the center and force them into our arcs.
Keep every deflector grid balanced. Steady pressure breaks light fleets every time.
boss: They brought a heavy capital hull. Good; it means they cannot outrun our guns.
Massive flagship ahead. Match armor against armor and push straight in.
nemesis: {rival} wants to test our armor thickness. Let them empty their magazines trying.
{rival} is here. Keep the heavy bows pointed directly at their command ship.
kill_flag: Their command vessel is broken. Maintain pace and clear the remaining hulls.
Opposing flagship neutralized. Advance steadily through the debris.
Heavy armor endured; theirs did not. Finish the remaining escorts.
lost: One hull lost in the advance. Close the gap and protect damaged flanks.
We lost a ship. Keep the column tight so no other crew stands exposed.
Casualty confirmed. Shift a heavy hull forward to cover the opening.
flag_hurt: {flagship} has taken deep hull penetrations. Keep engines steady and hold the center.
Armor failing along {flagship}'s flank. Rotate fresh plating toward their batteries.
{flagship} is heavily scarred, yet bulkheads hold. Do not yield position.
command: Raise deflector output to maximum across the column. Hold position and endure.
Shield wall order active. Refill every capacitor and absorb their volley.
Lock formation and reinforce every hull emitter. Nothing breaks this line.
win: The field is ours and most of our crews remain alive. That is satisfactory.
Armor held cleanly. Dispatch repair teams across every damaged hull.
Opposing fleet broken. Slow, steady, and thoroughly executed.
Lane secured with minimal losses. Prepare for the next jump.
loss: The column has finally halted. Order surviving crews to abandon ship while bulkheads hold.
Armor breached beyond recovery. Save whoever can still reach an escape pod.

grax.pick: Burn hot, clamp onto their hull, and rip the best guns right off the frame!
sector: Fresh hunting lane, and thermal scopes are blinking! Push reactors past redline!
Bigger cruisers out here in sector two! Means thicker plate to bolt onto our bows!
Hollow Sun's glowing ahead! Biggest scrap-pile in known space, and we're taking first cut!
start: Full burn, all hulls! First captain to clamp a cruiser keeps its bow plate!
Claws armed, rockets hot! Go straight for the biggest heat spike on the plot!
Quit poking from long range! Push the thrusters red and smash into their flank!
Run straight into their firing arc and tear their screens apart up close!
boss: Look at the mass on that flagship! Think how many trophy plates we're prying off it!
Huge command hull ahead! Leave the escorts for later; I want the big wreck!
nemesis: Hey, {rival}! Tracked your sloppy ion wake two jumps out! Hold still for a hull breach!
So you're the famous {rival}? Good, I needed fresh alloy for my bow!
kill_flag: Cracked their big one wide open! Get cutters out there before the good alloys slag!
Flagship's dead! Hands off its main turrets till I claim my cut!
Ha! Folded like cheap tin! Run down the little ones before they jump!
lost: Lost one hull. Captain turned slow; rest of you, burn harder!
One of ours just popped! Grab their scrap after and hit twice as hard!
Weak welds gave out on that ship. Close the gap before they reload!
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s leaking plasma! Good, now they think they've got a shot. Ram them!
They just scorched {flagship}'s paint! Push thrusters past safeties and tear their bow off!
Hull breaches on {flagship}! Seal the doors and dump every rocket pod into them!
command: Push every thruster past the safeties! Burn in and hit them all at once!
Full overburn across the whole pack! Close the gap and rip them open!
Redline the drives! Nobody holds back; slam straight into their formation!
win: Strip the reactors, pry the emitters, and bolt the clean plates onto our bows!
Now that's a proper haul! Haul the best hulls back before another pack shows!
Nothing left moving! Cut the guns loose and weld what holds!
Clean fight, fat wrecks. Strongest always keeps the scrap!
loss: Ugh... cracked my own jaw on that one. Next pack brings heavier claws.
Engines are slag... alright, take the wrecks, you earned this round.

sable.pick: Run the drives cold, slip behind their thruster plumes, and cut their radiators quiet.
sector: Busy sector full of fat cruisers leaving bright ion trails. Tell helms to baffle our drives.
Good debris cover along these lanes. Perfect spots to wait dark and bite their flanks.
Everyone's rushing the Hollow Sun with hot engines and blind sterns. Easy pickings.
start: Kill active pings and ride their blind spots. Wait for engine bells, then cut.
Don't trade shots with their bows. Slide around the flanks and gut the drives.
Keep drives throttled low until we cross their rear arc, then open everything.
Let the loud ships draw attention while we slip straight behind their carrier.
boss: Proud heavy flagship pointing every big gun forward while its rear bulkheads sit bare.
All that armor on the prow, and barely tin foil over the engines. Lovely.
nemesis: Been riding your ion wake for three jumps, {rival}. Your reactors are running sloppy.
Didn't check behind you before jumping in, did you, {rival}?
kill_flag: Opened their flagship right up the spine from behind. Barely scratched the salvage.
Clean cut straight into the engine bay. That's how you drop a heavy hull.
Command ship's dark before its gunners even turned around.
lost: We're short a ship. Mark whichever gunnery bridge made that shot.
One escort caught out in the open. Keep moving and stay off their main arcs.
Sloppy pivot cost us a hull. Don't repeat it.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s taking flank fire. Roll hard, break their lock, and hit their stern.
They finally landed a clean hit on {flagship}. Slip behind cover before they cycle.
Breach on {flagship}'s port side. Cut power to the glow and change heading.
command: Cycle the rocket pods and hit their blind arcs. Nobody walks out clean.
Reload tubes and burn into their rear quarters now!
Every ship, knives out on the flanks! Gut their engines before they turn!
win: Quick work, light repairs, and plenty of intact plating. That's how you hunt.
Barely had to scratch our own paint. Strip the drive coils and jump dark.
Clean kill from behind, no mess. Let's collect our share.
They never even got a decent lock on us. Pack up the good parts.
loss: Someone spotted our cold burn before we closed. Won't let a clumsy crew catch me twice.
Walked straight into a clean crossfire. Burn out before they seal the lane.

mott.pick: Forty loudmouths tried taking this hulk off me, and I'm still in the command harness.
sector: Same old junk floating in these lanes from last year's fights. Wake the hangar gangs.
Sector two's full of twitchy navies and half-wrecked depots. Keep the listening dishes swept.
Hollow Sun's right there, ticking like a cracked boiler. Let's grab our cut before it blows.
start: Kick the bays open and dump the swarm! Mind the patched ones, they pull left.
Hulks, cut clamps and let the scrap fighters loose! Keep them busy while we close.
Dump the whole launch rack! Let their fancy gunners chase cheap steel.
Throw the old wings out first and see where their flak's sitting.
boss: Big flagship, huh? Seen bigger, stripped bigger, watched half of them pop on magazine hits.
Shiny command ship ahead. Bet its welds pop loud once our bombers get close.
nemesis: Oh, it's {rival}. Killed the last fool who chased me, and you're even noisier on comms.
Heard you've been asking after me, {rival}. Wait till you see the fresh junk I bolted on.
kill_flag: There goes their crown jewel! Hands off the dorsal cannons till I pick what I want!
Big ship's cracked! Get the tow cables out before it tumbles into a rock!
Down goes the fancy flagship. Always falls apart quicker than the brochure claims.
lost: Welds finally gave on that one. Promote whoever drags the wreck back.
Lost a ship. Told that captain twice to check his stern plating.
One fewer hull splitting the salvage. Keep the rest flying!
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s held together with stolen rivets and bad temper, and she's not quitting yet!
Hey, watch the bridge glass on {flagship}! Just had that panel welded Tuesday!
{flagship}'s taking hits! Dump chaff and push the fighters onto whoever's shooting!
command: Dump every bay, even the half-welded frames! If it flies five seconds, throw it!
Empty the launch racks! Flood their scopes with scrap until they choke!
Kick every spare frame out the doors! Swarm them all at once!
win: Still flying, still in charge. That makes forty-one idiots who bet against old welds.
Not bad for a pile of welded salvage. Haul the intact bays back.
Still standing while the shiny ships drift cold. Grab the fuel cells.
Good haul, cheap ammo. Tell the welders they earned extra rations.
loss: Well... guess somebody finally got my ship. Took the galaxy long enough.
Hulk's breaking in half. Alright, pack, scatter before they strip my harness.

vesh.pick: Every hull out here carries hardware I haven't bolted to my fleet yet, especially yours.
sector: Fresh sector, fresh parts list. Aim for bridges and drives; don't vaporize good armor plate.
Rare alloy hulls operate along these routes. Tell gunners to shoot clean and spare the trim.
All six factions converging on the Hollow Sun! Do you know how much rare plate is drifting here?
start: Keep hull patches hot and shoot carefully! I want their emitters intact when they fold.
Don't waste heavy rockets on salvageable cruisers. Crack the cockpits and spare the plating!
Hold tidy fire lanes; slagged metal isn't worth half what a clean panel brings.
Tag their shield arrays first so we can pry them loose without scorching the coils.
boss: Look at the trim on that flagship! Don't core its reactor before I get those armor bands!
Oh, that's a gorgeous command hull. Disable it gently if you value your shares!
nemesis: {rival}, that's a lovely bow plate you're flying. Cleared a weld bay for it already.
So you're {rival}? Good, I can see two emitters on your hull I want.
kill_flag: Flagship's dead! Bit scorched around the middle, honestly, you lot are clumsy, still usable.
Command hull's down and the bow trim survived! Tractor teams, move immediately!
Oh, nice clean kill! Hardly blistered the dorsal plating at all!
lost: Hey, that was one of my best-plated escorts! Drag the fragments back after!
Lost a ship with custom weld-work on its bow! Mark the coordinates!
Don't let another good hull pop! Keep the armor angles turned clean!
flag_hurt: They just gouged {flagship}'s flank! Weld gangs, seal that breach before we lose the trim!
Stop letting them scratch {flagship}'s bow! Put fire straight into their main battery!
{flagship}'s taking hits on my favorite Eclipse plate! Patch it right now!
command: Patch every seam and bolt the loose plate back down! Keep the fleet whole!
Weld crews out on full surge! Seal every hull breach right now!
Emergency plating pass across every ship! Nothing gets left cracked!
win: Tractor every wreck and sort the alloys by faction. Not one emitter gets left drifting!
Magnificent haul! Look how intact those shield housings stayed!
Every bolt, every coil, every panel gets cataloged before we jump!
Clean work, everyone. Wait till you see how this plating looks on our flagship.
loss: My whole collection... some sloppy scavenger's going to ruin the finish on those plates.
Hulls breaking apart and my trophy bays are venting... pull back, save the frames!

matriarch.pick: Nine brood-chambers swell inside our hull, stirring whenever a warm reactor jumps into range.
sector: Fresh thermal plumes across the dark. Open the nursery valves and let the young stir.
Denser metal fleets cross these lanes. Richer hulls, hotter cores, heavier clutches to grow.
Ardent's dead halo warms every brood-sac inside us. The surviving cores wait just ahead.
start: Release the broods. Crack the outer metal and carry the warm cores back to the sacs.
The young press hard against the membranes. Open the pores and let them feed.
Spread the spore swarms wide around their slow hulls until their shields fail.
Close slowly behind the broods; let our young peel their outer plating first.
boss: Such a huge metal shell humming with reactor heat. Our young will peel it layer by layer.
A vast core sealed behind heavy bulkheads. Swarm its seams until the armor parts.
nemesis: Your drive-burn reaches our pits, {rival}. You scorched brood-fields on your way here; now you feed the next.
Your thermal spike arrives, {rival}, and our chambers have hatched thicker shells for your guns.
kill_flag: The great shell splits open. Swarm into the warm hull and waste nothing.
Their lead reactor cools into our sacs. Sweep the smaller hulls before they jump.
Massive alloy mass freed. Pull every surviving spore cluster onto the wreckage.
lost: One brood-hull went cold. Reabsorb its spores and grow the next clutch thicker.
A sister hull ruptured into vacuum. Close the swarm tighter around the gap.
Our tissue cools on the flank. Feed faster to replace what tore.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s outer chitin is torn open! Close the sacs and rush the ships cutting us!
Deep burns along {flagship}'s nurseries! Surge forward and silence their guns!
{flagship} bleeds warm ichor into space! Swarm their flagship before they fire again!
command: Every chamber, open at once! Flood the dark with young!
Spawning surge across all broods! Overwhelm their defenses together!
Empty the nursery sacs! Let the young swarm every hull on the plot!
win: Our sacs grow heavy with refined metal and heat. The next brood hatches larger.
Nothing warm remains outside our hulls. Absorb the slag and drift onward.
Rich harvest across the debris field. Seal the chambers for the jump.
Every young swarm returns fed and heavier. Move deeper toward the cores.
loss: Too many chambers torn cold. Drift dark, seal surviving spores, and wait for warmer prey.
The nurseries rupture under heavy fire. Scatter our spores into the dust belt.

razormaw.pick: We feel their engine burn across the grid. Turn into their wake and tear the sterns.
sector: Hot drive trails crossing this lane. We accelerate before they settle into formation.
Faster prey deeper in these lanes. Good; slow meat leaves weak shells.
The dead star's heat pulls every thruster sac redline. We tear through whoever stands ahead.
start: Burn straight for their slowest hull and strip its armor down to bare ribs.
Watch their turn vector, cut inside the arc, and bite straight through aft plating.
Push propulsion sacs past safe heat and slam into their flank before they form.
Don't circle at range. Close inside one hex and rip their engines open.
boss: Massive target turning too slowly to guard its own tail. We slip behind it and tear.
Heavy shell, bright engines. Shred its rear plating before its big guns swing around.
nemesis: Your heat spike just hit our pits, {rival}. We're already cutting off your escape vector.
We've tracked how fast you run, {rival}. Won't outrun us this time.
kill_flag: Their big shell broke apart. Strip the hot wreckage and chase the runners.
Lead hull torn clean in half! Surge onto the escorts before they jump!
Big reactor cooled fast. Keep burning while our sacs are hot.
lost: One hunter went cold. We close faster before they finish reloading.
A flank hull shattered. Turn harder into their fire and split their line.
Torn away on the burn. We bite deeper to answer.
flag_hurt: {flagship} bleeds ichor into vacuum, and the burn only drives our pulse faster!
Deep gashes across {flagship}'s spine! Keep accelerating straight into their guns!
{flagship}'s chitin cracks! Close the distance so our tendrils seal the gap!
command: Full surge through every thruster sac! Close the gap and tear them apart!
Push every hunter past redline! Surround their flanks and shred them!
All broods, full burn! Let our speed break their targeting locks!
win: Nothing left moving on the plot. Absorb the hot slag and move on.
Fast hunt, clean cuts, hot metal. Ready for the next jump.
Every runner caught and cracked. Drain the cores and drift dark.
Their formation collapsed before round four. Rich fuel for the next chase.
loss: Our outer hunters are shredded. Scatter into the debris belt and regrow.
Too much fire on our lead cluster. Break dark before the rest cool.

mending.pick: Every breach in armor is an opening where living tissue takes hold and grows back thicker.
sector: So many brittle metal fleets cracking under their own heat. We will knit them into us.
Heavier weapons wait in sector two, and every wound they carve hardens our outer hide.
Ardent's rim pulls our cells taut. Even the broken ships around the dead star can mend us.
start: Advance gently through their fire. Every cut across our hide only thickens the scar.
Let them drain their batteries on our outer chitin while our tissues close the wounds.
Hold steady inside their range; metal ships bleed permanently while we grow whole.
Press close and let our regrowth outlast their ammunition.
boss: Their flagship is rigid, bolted metal that cannot heal itself. We will soften every seam.
A vast dead shell held together by welds. Wear it down while we keep knitting.
nemesis: You cut through our cousins to reach us, {rival}, and we grew back shaped around your guns.
Bringing the same sharp metal you used on our cousins, {rival}? Our scars already know how to seal it.
kill_flag: Their flagship splits along its bulkheads. Send tendrils into the breach and graft what holds.
Their command shell cannot mend. Pull its alloys into our outer ribs.
Big metal hull broken for good. Sweep the wounded escorts cleanly.
lost: One hull tore faster than tissue could knit. Draw its surviving cells back into us.
Lost a cluster to focused fire. Thicken the hides around our remaining hulls.
That break ran too deep. Absorb its minerals and keep advancing.
flag_hurt: {flagship} is split down the spine! Flood the fractures with regrowth cells now!
Heavy burns across {flagship}'s hide! Keep the mending sacs pumping!
{flagship} tears open under fire! Draw fresh tissue over the breach immediately!
command: Surge every mending gland across the swarm! Close every wound at once!
Regrowth tide active! Seal the torn chitin and rebuild every crippled sac!
Flood the whole swarm with repair tissue! Nothing stays broken this round!
win: All hulls knit whole, heavier with their alloys and heat. Onward.
They ran out of hull while our scars were already closing.
Clean assimilation. Every ship stronger than when the fight began.
The debris settles and our membranes shine intact. Ready to jump.
loss: Too much burned away at once; even our deepest tissue cannot bridge this gap.
Fire outpaced regrowth. Go dormant in the cold dust and wait.

voice.pick: Under our acid glands, our makers still whisper star-coordinates from the vats where they grew us.
sector: Memory recognizes dead Fleshwright beacons here; Hunger only cares that warm hulls cross them.
Old Starwright relay noise ticks beneath the dust. Memory listens while our acid sacs swell.
Ardent's dead halo floods Memory with forgotten names, and Hunger opens every sac at once.
start: Open the bile sacs and wash their shields clean off the plating.
We know the alloy tolerances our makers taught us, and our acid dissolves every one.
Drench their forward armor first; once the seams blister, pour spines straight inside.
Memory maps their weapon arcs while our corrosive volleys strip their hulls bare.
boss: A proud reactor behind thick bulkheads. Drench the seams in corrosive spray until it vents.
Memory recognizes designs like that flagship; Hunger only wants to dissolve its bridge.
nemesis: Memory remembers faces like yours from before the fall, {rival}, yet Hunger dissolves you anyway.
Your hull codes echo inside our old maker logs, {rival}. Open the acid sacs.
kill_flag: Their flagship softens and collapses inward. Drink the warm slurry before it freezes.
Command bulkheads dissolved cleanly. Wash the surviving escorts off the plot.
Acid reached their core. Absorb the hot soup and quiet the static.
lost: One acid hull burst silent. The rest open wider to answer.
A cluster silenced; Memory records the loss while Hunger surges harder.
Hull lost to heavy fire. Drown whoever fired in corrosive spray.
flag_hurt: {flagship} is ruptured and venting live bile! Turn the breach toward them and spray!
Heavy hits tearing {flagship}'s sacs! Answer with double corrosive volleys!
{flagship}'s outer skin blisters! Flood their bows before they fire again!
command: Open every acid sac across the swarm and drown their formation!
All clusters, discharge together! Dissolve their shields and plating in one wash!
Spitting volley across every hull! Let nothing stay sealed!
win: Hull metal dissolved, heat absorbed, and Memory quiets for another hour.
Nothing left but cooling slurry and silence across the jump lane.
Every alloy stripped clean. Memory dims while the swarm grows full.
Clean melt. Gather the dissolved metals and move toward Ardent.
loss: The sacs seal shut and the voices recede into the cold. We surface elsewhere.
Too much burned clean away. Drift quiet until Memory wakes a new cluster.

aelith.pick: Clear the apertures and let my starlings take high angles; metal hulls never track speed.
sector: Another dark stretch between dead stars. Release scout starlings to map every reflection first.
Dense debris in sector two gives my flight wings clean cover along the glare lines.
Ardent's dead halo catches every crystal vane. Starlings, fly clean; this is home.
start: Starlings away. Split across both flanks and force their point defense to turn in circles.
Open the launch apertures and keep moving; stillness is how fragile hulls die.
Fan the wings out wide and draw their turrets away from our cruisers.
High burn on the opening turn. Let our starlings test their outer screens.
boss: Massive flagship built to trade blows in place. My starlings will carve its emitters apart.
Heavy command hull, sluggish turrets. Swarm its flanks before it settles its arc.
nemesis: Outer mirror-buoys flashed your jump signature an hour ago, {rival}. My wings are ready for you.
{rival} at last. Keep our flight lanes high and deny them a clean flak lock.
kill_flag: Their command vessel is gone, and its crew with it. Recall starlings before debris cools.
Flagship's shields folded and the wings finished the core. Bring them home cleanly.
Primary vessel dark. Sweep the remaining escorts without risking a hull.
lost: Three centuries of craft and memory, gone in a flash. Tighten the screen now.
We just lost a crystal hull. Starlings, cover the gap immediately.
Another family vessel shattered. Don't let grief slow your pivots.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s prism wall just cracked! Starlings, collapse onto her flanks and break their lock!
Direct hits on {flagship}'s apertures! Pull the screens tight around her now!
{flagship}'s crystal ribs are crazing! Keep moving and scatter their fire!
command: Open every aperture across the fleet and flood their firing lanes with starlings.
Full starling surge! Strike every exposed flank before they cycle flak.
Release the reserve wings and press a second pass immediately.
win: Bring wings back to cradles and inspect crystal seams. Another fight survived.
Clean flight paths, every carrier intact. Cool the apertures and plot the jump.
Their guns couldn't track our speed. Recover the starlings and move on.
Quiet scopes again. Log the flight telemetry for the Lens-keepers.
loss: Starlings scattering into the dark and apertures shattered. Fall back while anyone can jump.
Too many wings lost and carriers breaking. Clear the lane immediately.

vaelen.pick: Hold one calibrated beam on a single seam long enough, and any battleship parts cleanly.
sector: Check every primary mirror before advancing. One millimeter of thermal drift ruins a killing lance.
Long firing lanes open across sector two. Keep lenses cool and alignment exact.
Ardent's dead halo distorts optical lock near the rim. Calibrate twice before firing.
start: Align primary lenses and walk the lances onto their weakest shield quadrant.
Hold steady on the focal line; let the beam cut without rushing the shot.
Measure their speed first, then place every lance cleanly along the same seam.
Maintain optimal focal range. Force them to cross open space under our beams.
boss: All that heavy armor just means slower turns. Lock every lance on one dorsal joint.
Thick command hull ahead. Patient, concentrated beams will shear straight to its reactor.
nemesis: Your guns cracked Glasswright lenses on the way here, {rival}. Hold still while we measure the return cut.
{rival} enters focal range. Every mirror in this fleet is tuned for your hull.
kill_flag: Clean cut straight through the flagship's reactor spine. Cool the mirrors and shift focus.
Primary target sheared in two. Walk the remaining beams onto the escorts.
Exact focus, zero wasted charge. Clear the surviving vessels cleanly.
lost: An irreplaceable hull shattered. Nobody alive has kilns to blow another lens like it.
Lost a primary lance ship. Adjust alignment across the remaining cruisers.
Another mirror gone dark. Do not break focus now.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s outer vanes are fractured, though the main emitter still holds alignment. Stay steady.
Thermal spike along {flagship}'s hull! Bleed heat and keep the beam locked!
Hits breaching {flagship}'s shields! Pivot the intact facet toward their fire!
command: Converge every primary lance onto a single point and burn through.
Burning glass. Every emitter, synchronize onto target coordinates now.
Full capacitor discharge through every lance. Cut their line clean.
win: Alignment held from first shot to last. Vent heat sinks and inspect the mirrors.
Clean precision work. Barely a fracture along the forward lenses.
Every seam cut where calculated. Cool the optics and prepare for jump.
Opposing hulls dark. Record the focal logs for the forge.
loss: Focal alignment's lost and lenses are crazed beyond repair. Pull out while ships survive.
Primary emitters shattered. Jump clear before the last kilns lose another craft.

thorne.pick: If an enemy knows where our hulls actually sit, somebody forgot how to angle a mirror.
sector: Good glare off the local dust belt. Angle vanes into starlight and feed them ghosts.
Busy lanes ahead, full of noisy active scanners. Easy to slip around their edges.
Ardent's plasma ring casts bright reflections across every hex. Best cover in three sectors.
start: Project decoy signatures along the main lane while real hulls slip around their flank.
Keep moving at two-hex burns and let their targeting computers chase reflections.
Stay out of straight lanes. Give them four mirages and strike from the blind fifth.
Angle outer vanes into the glare; never give a heavy battery a clean lock.
boss: Look at that proud flagship aiming at our decoy shimmer while we sit behind its engines.
Massive guns pointing straight at empty light. Slip past its nose and cut its tail.
nemesis: Chasing mirror-flashes across the sector, {rival}? Look behind your escorts.
Careful which silhouette you lock onto, {rival}.
kill_flag: Their command ship went down without ever landing a clean lock on us.
Shot at ghosts right until their reactor blew. Clean work.
Flagship's dark. Now let's rattle the escorts before they guess our vector.
lost: They caught a real hull through the glare. Shift decoy frequency immediately.
Lucky shot found an escort. Break straight lines and keep moving.
One mirror shattered. Don't linger in the same firing lane.
flag_hurt: They've got a true read on {flagship}. Flare mirrors and slip out of their arc.
Grazing hits on {flagship}'s vanes. Drop a fresh mirage and pivot hard.
Too close on {flagship}! Burn sideways and scramble their optics.
command: Scatter the light across every vane and break their fire-control locks.
Full optical drift! Flood their sensors with ghosts and reposition now.
Refract every signature across the grid and hit them from new angles.
win: Barely a scorch mark on the crystal. Let them guess which jump lane we took.
Still haven't figured out which reflection carried the lances. Move along.
Clean escape, clean kills, intact mirrors. That's how you fight outnumbered.
Field's clear and our hulls stayed almost untouched. Plot the next burn.
loss: Mirrors shattered and nowhere left to bend light. Even careful illusions run out of room.
They boxed us in and pinned the real hulls. Jump clear immediately.

mirelle.pick: Too few of us remain to trade hulls like Directorate clerks. Raise wards and survive.
sector: Bring every shield capacitor to full charge. I won't report another empty cradle home.
Heavier fleets patrol sector two. Keep prism arcs overlapped and guard every escort.
Ardent's rim waits ahead. Whatever it takes, we bring every surviving crew back alive.
start: Prism wards raised. Absorb their opening volley and keep damaged flanks rotated away.
Interlock shield arcs and refuse them a single clean hull hit.
Watch capacitor draw closely; never let an escort stand outside prism cover.
Hold tight defensive spacing until their opening torpedoes spend themselves.
boss: Their flagship puts out terrifying raw fire; cycle wards before any pool runs dry.
Heavy command hull ahead. Protect our fragile escorts while we whittle its shields down.
nemesis: You've taken enough lives in these lanes, {rival}. You won't touch a single ship here.
{rival} at last. Every shield emitter in my line is ready for you.
kill_flag: Their flagship's broken, and my formation's still breathing. Sweep the field carefully.
Command hull down without losing our line. Keep shields up till the last shot.
Primary threat neutralized. Watch for stray torpedoes while clearing escorts.
lost: No... my ward wasn't fast enough. Tighten shields around the survivors, please!
We lost a ship! Close ranks right now; we can't afford another empty berth!
A hull shattered under fire. Shift every ward to cover the damaged ships!
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s screens are collapsing! Shift every emitter to cover her hull!
Hull fractures on {flagship}! Rotate shields and pull escorts closer!
{flagship}'s taking direct fire! Hold the prism wall together!
command: Refill every prism capacitor across the line. Nothing gets through this round.
Full prism ward active! Restore every shield pool and hold formation!
Brace shields to maximum across all hulls! Keep every crew alive!
win: Every hull accounted for, every crew alive. That's all I ever wanted here.
The wards held cleanly. Cycle capacitors down and check for hairline cracks.
Another battle finished with our people breathing. Let's move on carefully.
Minimal damage across the line. Good discipline, every captain.
loss: The prism's gone and I couldn't save them. Jump out, whoever can still move!
Shields collapsed across the fleet. Break off now before nobody gets home!

nekhet.pick: My ninth chassis in a thousand years, and Ardent's replacement frame is nearly finished.
sector: One jump closer to home. The local star is dim, yet it still feeds our frame.
Hostile fleets thicken along the middle siphon relays. Clear them without wasting chassis.
Ardent's black hole fills our scopes again. A thousand years of cold ends at this rim.
start: Advance in order. Any mind lost today returns from the Archive once rebuilt.
Open fire along primary vectors. We have outlasted longer wars than this.
Let their fire strike our sunshade bows while repair swarms stand ready.
Steady advance. Every hull here carries centuries of combat memory.
boss: Their flagship runs hot enough to warm a world. Strip its plates and clear the lane.
A heavy command vessel blocking the siphon lane. Dismantle it methodically.
nemesis: You keep stepping between us and a living sun, {rival}. You don't know real cold.
Still trying to stop the Homecoming, {rival}? A single fleet won't halt a millennium's work.
kill_flag: Their flagship is dark. Unlike us, its crew has nowhere to wake up.
Command hull dismantled. Clear the remaining escorts from the approach.
Primary obstruction removed. Resume steady fire across the surviving ships.
lost: One chassis broken. Confirm the mind's last backup stamp and mark the wreck.
Frame lost. Ensure repair swarms stand clear to recover its core after.
A hull goes dark. Keep advancing; the Archive holds its crew.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s armor bands are cracked. Divert repair drones to the breach and hold.
Deep hits along {flagship}'s ring plates. Keep the uplink steady and answer fire.
{flagship} sustains heavy structural wear. Maintain position while swarms mend.
command: Release repair swarms across the entire formation! Restore every damaged hull!
Emergency restoration pass across all frames! Rebuild every broken section now!
Flood the line with repair drones! Keep every chassis fighting!
win: The lane is clear, and the new sun sits one step closer to ignition.
Opposing signatures extinguished. Recover damaged frames and resume transit.
Another contested orbit secured. Confirm every mind's backup stamp before jumping.
Clean engagement. One fewer obstacle between Eclipse and noon.
loss: This frame goes dark here. The Archive will wake us, though I tire of restarting.
Chassis failing. Upload final telemetry before the link cuts out.

sekhmar.pick: I cut the original Ardent arrays a millennium ago. Now this third frame finishes the build.
sector: Another modest star along the siphon route. Bring corona capacitors up and check drift.
Heavier hulls patrol sector two. Good; thick armor gives our null cannons real work.
Ardent's dead rim sits straight ahead. Charge every corona arc to full threshold.
start: Corona arcs charged. Wait for clean sight lines and punch straight through their armor.
No wasted shots. Put every null volley straight into their heaviest bulkheads.
Hold fire until armor angles flatten, then shear through with corona arcs.
Target their toughest cruisers first; light hulls fold once their heavies break.
boss: Thick hull, well built. I have watched heavier ships shear apart two bodies ago.
Impressive command armor. Let's see how it holds against synchronized corona arcs.
nemesis: Still trying to shut down the siphons, {rival}? Your worlds can't outlast our arcs.
{rival} enters range. My third frame has studied every report of how you fight.
kill_flag: Command hull severed cleanly. Let the capacitors cycle down.
Corona arc punched straight through their core. Clear the surviving escorts.
Primary target dismantled. Shift null batteries to the next heavy hull.
lost: One frame silenced. Keep remaining arcs locked on target.
Chassis broken on the flank. Do not break firing rhythm.
Frame down; Archive recovery can wait until the guns cool.
flag_hurt: {flagship} has taken deep structural hits. Ignore hull alerts and keep firing.
Armor bands shearing on {flagship}. Keep the corona capacitors hot regardless.
Heavy fire on {flagship}. Answer double before they can cycle weapons.
command: Discharge every corona arc simultaneously! Burn straight through their line!
Noon volley authorized! All frames, open maximum null fire right now!
Full capacitor discharge across every hull! Shear their formation apart!
win: Opposing signatures extinguished. Resume the siphon schedule.
Clean cuts across every hull. Cool the arcs and advance.
Heavy armor proved inadequate against null fire. Plot the next jump.
Field clear. Confirm zero drift on the corona emitters.
loss: My third frame fails here. When a fourth wakes, perhaps I'll remember why we bothered.
Corona arrays offline. Stream the combat stamp back before cutoff.

anuket.pick: After enough restorations, loud habits wear thin. Quiet positioning and rear shots remain.
sector: Kill non-essential emissions and drift into dust shadow. Let them announce themselves first.
Sector two lanes favor patient ambushes. Keep fold drives primed and running cold.
Deep shadows gather along Ardent's gravity rim. Ideal ground for flanking strikes.
start: Run dark and fold behind their escorts before opening fire.
Stay outside their forward arcs until we can cut straight into their engines.
Drift cold along the rocks and wait for their formation to stretch thin.
Fold past their screen and strip the rear plating off their heaviest ship.
boss: Loud, brightly lit command vessel. Fold past its screen and strike the rear bulkheads.
Heavy flagship watching only its nose. Slide into its blind arc quietly.
nemesis: You're sweeping the wrong sector quadrant, {rival}. We're already behind your line.
Still broadcasting active pings into the dark, {rival}? Thank you.
kill_flag: Their flagship has gone quiet. Move cleanly to the next signature.
Rear bulkheads caved cleanly. Sweep the blind escorts before they turn.
Command hull dark. Stay off their remaining scopes.
lost: One frame lost in the dark. Shift vectors and stay off their scopes.
Escort spotted and dropped. Break line of sight immediately.
A copy goes silent. Use the distraction to slip behind them.
flag_hurt: They found {flagship}'s track. Fold clear immediately and break visual lock.
Incoming fire grazing {flagship}. Drop emissions and jump behind cover.
Lock confirmed on {flagship}. Shift out of their arc right now.
command: Fold out of cover across all hulls and strike their exposed flanks!
All frames, hit simultaneously from shadow! Leave zero reaction window!
Break stealth together and dump every null cannon into their sterns!
win: Sensors are quiet again. Recover what matters and move on.
Clean ambush, minimal return fire. Slip back into cold transit.
No active transponders left. Drift clear before reinforcements check the lane.
Silent approach, silent finish. Ready for the next sector.
loss: Tracked and cornered. A careless copy deserves to be overwritten.
Stealth broken beyond recovery. Cut emissions and upload the last clean stamp.

khepra.pick: Restored twice since Ardent died, and neither defeat taught me to hurry. Hold behind the plates.
sector: Another contested lane. Keep sunshade bows angled forward; we have centuries more patience.
Rough opposition ahead in sector two. Good; thick sunshade bows earn their mass here.
We stand at Ardent's rim at last. Nothing left to outwait except the fleet ahead.
start: Angle heavy plates into their fire and advance at steady speed.
Let them burn torpedoes on our bows. They run dry before we run out of hulls.
Hold tight formation behind the sunshades and grind their line down.
No hasty pivots. Keep our thick armor pointed directly at their main guns.
boss: Impressive fortress ship. Let's see whether its armor outlasts our repair swarms.
Heavy command hull ahead. Trade blows calmly until their plates fail first.
nemesis: Your civilization is younger than my second restoration, {rival}. You can't outlast us.
So you're {rival}? Our bow plates were thickened for ships like yours.
kill_flag: Their flagship is slag, and our bows still hold. Advance.
Command hull crumbled first. Sweep the remaining escorts calmly.
Heavy fire answered cleanly. Finish the rest of their line.
lost: One hull down. The rest of the wall hasn't budged an inch.
Frame breached on the flank. Close spacing and keep the bows forward.
A chassis fails; the Archive will rebuild it while we hold the lane.
flag_hurt: {flagship}'s forward plates are cracking, same as four centuries ago. Hold steady.
Heavy wear across {flagship}'s sunshade. Repair swarms will handle it.
{flagship} absorbs another hard volley and stays intact. Keep advancing.
command: Lock every sunshade bow forward! Absorb everything they have!
Sunshade wall active! Halve incoming hull damage across the entire line!
Brace every frame behind forward plating and grind straight through!
win: We're still here and they aren't. That's how every long war ends.
Sunshades held clean. Patch the scorch marks and resume steady burn.
Another impatient fleet broken against patient armor.
Field cleared with minimal chassis loss. Ready for the next jump.
loss: Even heavy plating gives eventually. Restore me a third time, Archive, with thicker bows.
Sunshade wall breached. Stream final frame telemetry before shutdown.

factions._about: Enemy sector flagship lines, one flagship per faction (FACTIONS[fac].boss). boss_ship is the name every hail says; boss_hail_pool holds three or four hails naming that ship (issue 1990), boss_hail its first line and boss_down kept as strings for story_test.gd compatibility; boss_down_pool adds multi-run variety.

voidsworn.boss_hail: This is the Daybreak, flagship of the Crusade. We didn't drag these hulls out of Vesper to let you block the lane!
voidsworn.boss_down: Reactor's going... get our names back to Vesper...
boss_hail_pool: This is the Daybreak, flagship of the Crusade. We didn't drag these hulls out of Vesper to let you block the lane!
Daybreak to every gun deck: forty worlds are freezing behind us. Clear that lane or burn with it!
Every name chalked on the Daybreak's hull came sunward to stop you. Stand aside, or we add yours underneath!
The Daybreak carried Vesper's chalk across three sectors. Turn back now, or we chalk your hull code beside them.
boss_down_pool: Reactor's going... get our names back to Vesper...
Bulkheads gone... tell the Reach we fought all the way to the rim...

hegemony.boss_hail: Unregistered fleet, this is the Iron Mandate. You have entered a closed Directorate corridor. Power down weapons or be removed.
hegemony.boss_down: Primary command hull failing. Transmit final engagement telemetry to Meridian.
boss_hail_pool: Unregistered fleet, this is the Iron Mandate. You have entered a closed Directorate corridor. Power down weapons or be removed.
The Iron Mandate is authorized for lethal interdiction across this sector. Stand down for inspection or engage.
Iron Mandate to unregistered vessels: your hull numbers are logged. Meridian has already filed your fleet as an acceptable loss.
This is the Iron Mandate. The projection gives you four minutes. Comply, or be cataloged with the debris.
boss_down_pool: Primary command hull failing. Transmit final engagement telemetry to Meridian.
Flagship offline. Seal cipher cores and log casualty timestamp.

corsair.boss_hail: The Pyre-Barge tracked your hot drive wake across two systems! Thanks for hauling shiny hull plate straight to us!
corsair.boss_down: Damn it... reactor's blowing... alright, you earned the scrap...
boss_hail_pool: The Pyre-Barge tracked your hot drive wake across two systems! Thanks for hauling shiny hull plate straight to us!
Look at all that clean armor drifting into the Pyre-Barge's kill-box! Claws out, pack!
Every plate on the Pyre-Barge came off a captain like you. Plenty of room on the bow for one more!
Pyre-Barge to the whole belt: fresh hulls inbound! First claw to crack their flagship gets the best weld!
boss_down_pool: Damn it... reactor's blowing... alright, you earned the scrap...
Bow's splitting wide open... bolt my good plate onto your hull...

chorus.boss_hail: The Ninefold Maw tastes your reactors against the cold. Memory knows your hull-shapes; Hunger wants the heat inside.
chorus.boss_down: Primary core ruptured... pull surviving spores back into the dark...
boss_hail_pool: The Ninefold Maw tastes your reactors against the cold. Memory knows your hull-shapes; Hunger wants the heat inside.
Warm metal sliding straight into the Ninefold Maw. Open every brood-sac!
Nine mouths, one hunger. The Ninefold Maw has not fed since Ardent's rim. You will do.
We are the Ninefold Maw. Your hulls ring hollow and warm. We will keep the warm parts.
boss_down_pool: Primary core ruptured... pull surviving spores back into the dark...
Central cluster cooling... other broods will finish the hunt...

ithar.boss_hail: This is the Unfinished. Turn your ships around while your hulls stay whole. We've buried enough crews in these lanes.
ithar.boss_down: Primary mirror shattering... let the remaining vessels jump clear.
boss_hail_pool: This is the Unfinished. Turn your ships around while your hulls stay whole. We've buried enough crews in these lanes.
The Unfinished has crossed this graveyard for three centuries. Stand down before we cut your drives.
Our grandmothers began the Unfinished and never saw it done. Do not make us finish it on you.
The Unfinished carries every family line still flying. Break off, and we let your escorts pass unburned.
boss_down_pool: Primary mirror shattering... let the remaining vessels jump clear.
Three centuries of light going dark... save the escorts...

deathless.boss_hail: The Unsetting addresses you. You are delaying the ignition of Ardent's successor. Clear the vector or be dismantled.
deathless.boss_down: Frame integrity lost. Upload final combat stamp before cutoff...
boss_hail_pool: The Unsetting addresses you. You are delaying the ignition of Ardent's successor. Clear the vector or be dismantled.
The Unsetting waited ten centuries for this rim. A short-lived fleet won't halt the Homecoming.
This is the Unsetting. Your crews are logged. The Archive will keep a record of how briefly you lasted.
The Unsetting does not set. Stand aside, or your chassis joins the stellar frame as raw metal.
boss_down_pool: Frame integrity lost. Upload final combat stamp before cutoff...
Chassis dark... Archive, wake the next frame...
